ios.desc:
play. compete. repeat

ink. is a casual collection of retro‑style mini‑games designed to help you unwind or indulge your competitive side. Featuring simple controls, a nostalgic black‑and‑white aesthetic, and weekly leaderboards via Game Center, ink. keeps things fun, fast, and friendly.

Download ink. and discover some mini‑games that are both relaxing and challenging—play solo or top the global charts. It’s your cozy arcade in your pocket!
